Metadata.title: Bible Plan
Metadata.description: Read the Bible at your own pace: reading plans, reminders, a prayer journal, meditation, groups and trophies. Free and open source, no account needed to read.
Metadata.keywords: Bible, reading plan, daily reading, verse of the day, King James, reading reminders, prayer journal, meditation, reading group, prayer

hero.title: Read the Bible at your own pace, day after day.
hero.subtitle: Bible Plan builds a reading plan that fits your schedule, reminds you to read, and supports your prayer and meditation, alone or in a group. The web version is ready, free, and needs no account to read.
hero.verse: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
hero.counter: {count, plural, one {# person has already signed up} other {# people have already signed up}}
hero.waitlistLink: Or join the waitlist to follow what comes next
hero.screenshotAlt: Bible reading screen with highlighted verses and the selection panel

features.title: Already here, starting today
features.subtitle: Reading, praying and meditating with regularity: everything is open on the web version.

plans.title: A plan that fits you
plans.description: The whole Bible in a year, the Gospels in 30 days or 15 minutes a day: readings are spread over the days you have, and the plan adapts if you fall behind.

bible.title: A Bible to read, highlight and share
bible.description: Louis Segond 1910 and King James: six highlight colors saved to your account, two translations side by side, a verse copied or sent with a simple link.

reminders.title: Reminders at the right time
reminders.description: A notification at the time you choose, on your phone as on your computer, telling you what is left to read.

verse.title: A verse every day
verse.description: The verse of the day, illustrated for the time of day, in the translation you read.

prayer.title: A prayer journal
prayer.description: Write down your requests, mark when you prayed, and keep track of what was answered. Your requests stay private unless you choose to share them.

meditation.title: Meditate, pray, take notes
meditation.description: A timer for your times of meditation and prayer, and notes on the passage: key verse, reflection, how you will live it.

groups.title: Read together
groups.description: Invite your church, your small group or your family: a shared plan, comments on the reading of the day and shared prayer requests where everyone can say “I’m praying for you”.

progress.title: Regularity and trophies
progress.description: Your streaks, your activity calendar and badges that reward faithfulness, never quantity. No ranking: only you can see them.

privacy.title: Your data is yours
privacy.description: Free, open source (AGPL) and ad-free. Download all your data or delete your account whenever you want.

mobile.title: Mobile app
mobile.description: Bible Plan on iPhone and Android, to read and pray wherever you are, with a distraction-free prayer time.

preview.title: A look at the web app
preview.subtitle: Designed for your phone, it fits your computer too.

today.title: The verse of the day and your readings
today.description: Every day, the verse of the day then the readings of your plans, with a catch-up that does not guilt you.
today.alt: Today screen with the verse of the day and a reading plan

compare.title: Compare two translations
compare.description: Parallel reading shows two versions verse by verse, aligned even when the numbering differs.
compare.alt: Parallel reading screen of John 3 in King James and Louis Segond

calendar.title: A clear calendar
calendar.description: What is read, what is late: the plan adapts when you shift it.

prayer.title: A prayer journal
prayer.description: Your requests, the times you prayed and what was answered, private unless you share them.
prayer.alt: Prayer journal screen with a request shared with a group

groups.title: Read together
groups.description: A shared plan, everyone’s progress and prayer requests shared with your group.
groups.alt: Group screen with its reading plan and the progress of its members

achievements.title: Trophies for regularity
achievements.description: Bronze, silver and gold badges for faithfulness, with no ranking: only you can see them.
achievements.alt: Achievements screen with badges and their progress

waitlist.title: The waitlist is still open

welcome.title: Welcome to Bible Plan
welcome.body: Read the Bible at your own pace, day after day.

plans.title: A plan that fits you
plans.body: Pick a plan or make your own: the readings are spread over your days, and the plan adjusts if you fall behind.

prayer.title: Pray and meditate
prayer.body: Write down your prayer requests, take time to meditate on the day’s passage, and keep track of answered prayers.

offline.title: Everything stays on your phone
offline.body: No account or connection needed. An account will only back up your data, if you want one.

language.title: Your language
language.description: You can change it in the settings.

reminder.title: A daily reminder?
reminder.description: A notification at the time you choose, so you don’t forget your reading.

database.error: The app’s data could not be prepared. Close the app and open it again; if it happens again, write to us.

versions.failed: Downloading {version} failed. Check your connection and try again.
versions.note: To download: about 4 MB each, then readable offline.
versions.removeMessage: Its text will be removed from the phone. You can download it again; your highlights are kept.
